text: J. Carter Sporting Club Limited is Castore's trading name; the sports brand was started by Tom and Phil Beahon in 2015. Companies House lists J. Carter Sporting Club Limited (09670915) as an active private limited company, registered at 1 Central Street, Manchester, and its persons-with-significant-control register names Mr Philip Beahon and Mr Thomas Beahon as the two active persons with significant control.
